links.outcome: External validation discrimination of PIPRA versus development dataset
links.effect: AUC 0.73 (95% CI 0.69-0.77) vs 0.80 (0.77-0.82) in development; imperfect calibration at higher risks limits use of absolute risk estimates.
links.quote: PIPRA discriminated with an AUC of 0.73 (95% CI: 0.69-0.77), compared to the AUC of the original development dataset (0.80 (95% CI: 0.77-0.82)).

links.outcome: Need for local recalibration given imperfect calibration in external validation
links.effect: Imperfect calibration, particularly at higher risks, limits direct use of absolute risk estimates; local recalibration required before implementation.
links.quote: Local recalibration and dedicated implementation studies are required before considering its general implementation to guide targeted delirium prevention.

screen.reason: Prospective multicenter external validation of an existing predictive ML model (PIPRA) for postoperative delirium across four hospitals, evaluating discrimination and calibration.
